findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Превращаем хаос в систему" → 3 lines (4 words, 73.6px); "Разберём ваши процессы за 30 минут" → 3 lines (6 words, 44.8px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 16 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Ташкент · CRM · ERP · AI" above "Превращаем хаос в систему"; "До / после" above "Тот же бизнес — через 90 дней с ZOLVI"; "Через 90 дней" above "+34%"; "Услуги" above "Системы для бизнеса: CRM, ERP, POS, боты"; "Процесс" above "Результат виден с первой недели"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: ui-monospace — e.g. "TODO: подтвердить", "TODO: подтвердить", "TODO: подтвердить", "TODO: подтвердить"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: 27 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Ташкент · CRM · ERP · AI", "ZOLVI · Dashboard", "До / после", "До").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ✕
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 8 gradient fill(s): div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(160deg, rgb(58, 36, 24), rgb(42, 27, 22)) | div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(160deg, rgb(58, 36, 24), rgb(42, 27, 22)) | div.absolute.inset-0 → linear-gradient(160deg, rgb(58, 36, 24), rgb(42, 27, 22))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 13 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.btn.btn-primary → rgba(245, 181, 33, 0.6) 0px 10px 30px -12px | div.absolute.-inset-3 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | div.absolute.inset-0 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 14 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.sticky.top-0 1440px | div.flex.items-center 525px | section.marquee.overflow-hidden 1440px | ul.mt-6.flex-1 321px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 62 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 19 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 4 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (25, 4, 3, 3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Manrope, Unbounded, ui-monospace).
findings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 112 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 28 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The margins differ: 136px on the left, 161px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 1 section(s) have content at both edges and 9839px of nothing between: "Разберём ваши процессы за 30 минут"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: The h1 is 20px ("Разработка CRM, ERP и автоматизация бизнеса — Ташк").
findings.fix: Set the title at display size, or make the large text of the first screen the h1.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "−38%" (screen 7, 100% hidden); "2,1 s" (screen 7, 100% hidden); "−24%" (screen 7, 100% hidden); "200+" (screen 7, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Only 2 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: 5 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Превращаем хаос в систему" → 3 lines (4 words, 40.3px); "Тот же бизнес — через 90 дней с ZOLVI" → 3 lines (9 words, 26.2px); "Системы для бизнеса: CRM, ERP, POS, боты и AI" → 3 lines (9 words, 26.2px); "Сколько времени вернёт автоматизация?" → 3 lines (4 words, 26.2px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: 2 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.
